finding: v4.3.0 made grouped Info Row / Key-value Row containers transparent, weakening visual grouping.
root_cause: v430 CSS flattened .v430-flat and .v430-key-stack even though Theme 7 rule requires one homogeneous collection to have one shared surface boundary.
fix: Restore one shared surface with default background, border, radius and clipping; keep emphasis row semantic background inside the same block; restore comparison/details surface.
